name: Sprigatito
flavorText: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Fuecoco
flavorText: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

name: Quaxly
flavorText: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

name: Cetoddle
flavorText: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

name: Cetitan

attacks.name: Sweeping Tackle
attacks.text: This attack does 20 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

flavorText: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 20 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

flavorText: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Pawmi
flavorText: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

name: Kilowattrel

attacks.name: Skill Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Thunder Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Flittle
flavorText: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

name: Sandaconda

attacks.name: Sandstorm Spray
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. If you discarded any Energy in this way, your opponent shuffles their Active Pokémon and all attached cards into their deck.

flavorText: It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck.

name: Klawf

attacks.name: Adrenaline Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

name: Blissey

abilities.name: Busybody Nurse
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Your Active Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.

attacks.name: Happy Cyclone
attacks.text: Move all Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

flavorText: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

name: Tandemaus

attacks.name: Double Hit
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

flavorText: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

name: Cyclizar

attacks.name: Touring
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

flavorText: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.

name: Kirlia

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

flavorText: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Charizard

abilities.name: Battle Sense
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Discard the other cards.

attacks.name: Royal Blaze
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Leon card in your discard pile.

flavorText: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Lightning Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

flavorText: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Miraidon

attacks.name: Lightning Laser
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

flavorText: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Let's All Rollout
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has the Let's All Rollout attack.

flavorText: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

name: Hatenna
flavorText: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: Dragapult

attacks.name: Dragon Launcher
attacks.text: Discard a number of your Benched Dreepy up to the number of your opponent's Pokémon in play. Then, for each Dreepy you discarded in this way, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and do 100 damage to it. You can't choose the same Pokémon more than once. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

flavorText: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

name: Quagsire

attacks.name: Fickle Impact
attacks.text: If you have exactly 2, 4, or 6 Prize cards remaining, this attack does nothing.

flavorText: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

name: Koraidon

attacks.name: Rampaging Fang
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

name: Umbreon

attacks.name: Blindside
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Moon Mirage
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

flavorText: On the night of a full moon, or when it gets excited, the ring patterns on its body glow yellow.

name: Hydreigon

abilities.name: Tri Howl
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and attach any number of Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Discard the other cards.

flavorText: Only the central head has a brain. It is very intelligent, but it thinks only of destruction.

name: Roaring Moon

attacks.name: Vengeance Fletching
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each Ancient card in your discard pile.

flavorText: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.

name: Dragonite

abilities.name: Jet Cruise
abilities.text: Your Pokémon in play have no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

flavorText: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

name: Eevee

attacks.name: Continuous Steps
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Rayquaza

attacks.name: Jaw Lock
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Power Blast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

flavorText: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

name: Drampa

attacks.name: Raging Cannon
attacks.text: If all of your Benched Pokémon have at least 1 damage counter on them, this attack does 120 more damage.

flavorText: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.
